svg.text: Type a task the way you say it out loud
Saved and listed before anything is proposed.
A completed task stays in the list for 30 days, then moves here. It keeps every field it had.
Nothing on this screen has been deleted, and Restore puts a task back where it was.
Marsh is the ink for everything inert: finished, kept, out of the way, nothing asked of you.
Nothing has been completed in the last 30 days.
Tasks you finish stay in Today, ticked off, until the retention window passes.
the same control as in Settings, so the number is never in two places.
